hooks.command: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell appearance preferences to get dark mode' > /tmp/claude_dark_mode_backup 2>/dev/null || true
m=$(cat /tmp/claude_dark_mode_backup 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$m" ] && m=true; osascript -e "tell application \"System Events\" to tell appearance preferences to set dark mode to $m"
